user.title: Pure spa
user.description: How do you want to add the spa?

menu_options.discover: Search the spas of the local network
menu_options.manual: Enter the IP address of a spa already on the Wi-Fi
menu_options.pair: Connect a new spa to the Wi-Fi (pairing)

data_description.host: IP address of the spa on the local network. Reserve it in your router DHCP settings.

pair.title: Wi-Fi pairing
pair.description: Put the spa in Wi-Fi pairing mode before submitting. Home Assistant must be on the same network as the access point, with host networking.

data_description.ssid: 2.4 GHz network the spa must join.
data_description.bssid: MAC address of the 2.4 GHz radio of the access point the spa must join (aa:bb:cc:dd:ee:ff), not the 5 GHz one. Prefilled when Home Assistant is itself on 2.4 GHz Wi-Fi.
data_description.local_ip: Sent to the spa so that it can confirm the pairing.

progress.pairing: Sending the Wi-Fi settings to the spa. This can take up to one minute.

error.pairing_failed: The spa did not answer. Check the pairing mode, the BSSID and the password, then retry.

state.e90: E90 - Low or no water flow

update_failed.message: Unable to read the spa status: {error}

command_failed.message: The spa did not execute the command: {error}

entry_not_found.message: No Pure spa entry with ID {entry_id}.

entry_not_loaded.message: The Pure spa entry {entry_id} is not loaded.

temperature_heater_only.message: A temperature can only be set for the heater.

set_timer.name: Set timer
set_timer.description: Runs the filter, the heater or the sanitizer for some hours, now or after a delay. It replaces the previous timer of the same device. The spa does not report the timer before it starts.

hours.name: Duration
hours.description: How long the device runs, in hours (1 to 48).

delay.name: Delay
delay.description: Time before the device starts. Starts now when empty.

temperature.name: Temperature
temperature.description: Heater only: target temperature, in the unit of the spa. The current target when empty.

clear_timer.name: Clear timer
clear_timer.description: Clears the timer of the filter, the heater or the sanitizer. A running device stops.
